command: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -W clippy::redundant_clone -W clippy::needless_collect -W clippy::trivially_copy_pass_by_ref -W clippy::large_types_passed_by_value
notes: The remaining clone deliberately creates two independently retained directory leases so the contention regression is meaningful.
Two collections spawn every barrier-synchronized worker before joining; the third snapshots HashMap keys before mutation.
The four copy-by-reference diagnostics concern one-byte WcMode values.
No current diagnostic supports the historical large-Copy-by-value claim.
